note: Replay goldens of std-lolo-python (std-lolo-source with the Python vocabulary). Each case feeds the lowered program (orb lower, field orb) as the program/read answer (program/read has no substrate host in goldens, G-STD-262), with the installed operator names seeded in the entity. 123 operators of the pure categories (str, array, object, math, validate, json, arithmetic, comparison, logic, control) have a template. The 67 with no Python template render as a warning and a raising stub: array/cosine, array/groupBy, array/insert, array/nearest, array/partition, array/pmap, array/preduce, array/remove, array/removeItem, array/shuffle, bit/and, bit/not, bit/or, bit/rotl, bit/rotr, bit/shl, bit/shr, bit/xor, json/nodes, json/valid, math/acos, math/approach, math/asin, math/deg-rad, math/lerp, math/map, math/rad-deg, math/random, math/randomInt, math/wrap, object/clone, object/deepClone, object/deepMerge, object/equals, object/filter, object/mapKeys, object/mapValues, path, quasiquote, quote, row/matches, str/camelCase, str/collate, str/collate-key, str/decode-uri-component, str/encode-uri-component, str/kebabCase, str/replace-pattern, str/snakeCase, str/template, str/titleCase, str/to-number, str/uri-component-valid, tree/fold, tree/index, unquote, validate/check, validate/creditCard, validate/date, validate/email, validate/noneOf, validate/pattern, validate/phone, validate/url, validate/uuid, value/depth, value/key

cases.note: array/range with one argument is [0,n); with two it is [a,n). The one-argument form must not leave a placeholder.
array/range with one argument is [0,n); with two it is [a,n). The one-argument form must not leave a placeholder.
(- a b) is a subtraction; the unary template must not win over infix.
(- a) is a negation. The fixture does not pass orb validate (the checker rejects a unary minus), the lowered program is what the reader answers.
array/nth answers null past the end: a helper, with the default applied once.
Control of nth-past-end: the same read with no default.
object/get on a missing key answers null: a helper.
(/ a b) answers null when b is 0; default evaluates its argument once.
Control of divide-default: no default around the division.
A let inside a let body in expression position: one lambda per binding, because bindings are sequential.
A list whose head is a string that is not an operator is a list literal.
Control of list-plain: the head names an operator in the installed table, so it is a call.
An operator with no template is a named warning and a stub that raises when run, never a call to an undefined name.
